projectSummary: Carried as harms context for the existence and reported circumstances of the injury. Because only the abstract was read, no proportion from it is quoted, and a pooled case series has no denominator of exposed lifters in any event.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only, published in 2000, and a pooled case series cannot yield an incidence.
Case-report pooling is subject to strong reporting bias toward unusual presentations.

study.intervention: Pooled analysis of published cases of pectoralis major rupture.
study.population: A meta-analysis of 112 reported cases of rupture of the pectoralis major.

title: Rupture of the pectoralis major: a meta-analysis of 112 cases.
